name: Baked crispy chicken balls (no-fry)

source.author: Instagram — daniella_nutritionit (Hebrew caption)
source.notes: Oven-baked crispy chicken balls, no frying. Ground chicken breast seasoned, formed into balls, dipped in an egg-chili-soy wash, coated in breadcrumbs + sesame, baked. Breadcrumbs, sesame, salt and chili amounts weren't quantified — estimated (~40 g breadcrumbs, ~15 g sesame used as coating, ~½–1 tsp salt). No cooking oil (baked). Servings assumed 4.

serving_desc: ≈120 g cooked (~4-5 balls) — 500 g chicken batch ÷4
steps: Season and roll ground chicken into balls; dip in an egg-chili-soy wash; coat in breadcrumbs + sesame; bake crisp (no frying).

batch_totals.note: No frying oil — the low fat (~7 g/serving) is the whole point. Sodium ~650 mg/serving from soy + added salt.

him.verdict: One of the leanest, most protein-dense mains here — 32.5 g protein for just 235 kcal (~13.8 g protein per 100 kcal) because it's BAKED, not fried. Sesame adds calcium + healthy fat, and the chicken/egg bring selenium, zinc and choline (sperm micros). Ideal cutting protein. Only real watch: sodium (~650 mg/serving from soy + added salt); breadcrumbs are a minor refined carb.
flags: baked not fried — low fat (~7 g/serving)
suggested_mods: Use low-sodium soy and go easy on added salt — the one lever
Spray the balls lightly with oil + use panko for maximum crisp without frying
Serve over a big salad for fiber/lycopene/vitamin C

her_preconception.verdict: A good lean-protein option for her — high protein + choline (chicken + egg), selenium, iron (sesame/chicken) and a little calcium (sesame). Baked and fully cooked, no safety flags. The main caution is sodium (soy + salt). Not a big folate source — pair with greens.
prenatal_highlights: iron (sesame + chicken) + a little calcium (sesame); selenium

safety_advisories.note: Cook the ground chicken fully through (74 C / no pink) — standard for chicken balls.

suggested_mods: Use low-sodium soy to ease the salt
Serve with a leafy/veg side for folate + vitamin C (helps iron absorption)

cooking_guide: Mix the ground chicken with the paprika, salt and pepper — season generously, chicken breast is bland. (For juicier balls, a spoon of breadcrumbs in the mix + resting 15 min helps them hold.)
With wet hands, roll into even balls (even size = even baking); set on a tray.
In a separate bowl, beat the egg with the chili, soy sauce and pepper.
Dip each ball in the egg wash, then roll to coat in the breadcrumbs + sesame — the egg wash is what makes the crumb stick and crisp up.
Space them out on a lined tray (crowding steams them soft); for max crisp without frying, set them on a wire rack over the tray and lightly spray/brush with oil.
Bake at 200 C (400 F) ~20-25 min, turning once, until golden and cooked through (74 C, no pink). Panko crisps better than fine crumbs.
Optional: broil/grill 1-2 min at the end for extra crunch. Rest a couple of minutes before serving.
